events.title: Woodstock Festival Turns 57
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Reflection
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, hundreds of thousands descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. The Woodstock Festival. What an incredible moment in history, wasn't it?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year. His music continues to define generations.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away on this day in 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the trailblazing Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84. His innovative guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in the UK in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to that incredible medley, it's an album that truly stands the test of time.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' incredible catalogue, fronted by her distinctive voice, remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. The voice of a generation, still rocking stages and making headlines.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Single Turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Single Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A song of peace and hope that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The First iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: A quarter-century ago, Apple dropped the original iPod, completely changing how we carry our music. A true game-changer.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, which took place on this day in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Celebration
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating the iconic 007, from the gadgets to the timeless theme tunes. A true British institution.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire millions around the world.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eponymous double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showcased their incredible range.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the legendary Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His voice, stage presence, and incredible songs are truly immortal.
